description: "Ernest Linwood; or, The Inner Life of the Author" by Caroline Lee Hentz is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story revolves around Gabriella Lynn, a sensitive and aspiring young poet, who experiences harsh criticism from her teacher during a school presentation.
